You told your therapist last April that you wanted a year off from dating, yet here you are asking whether love will find you during that time.

I cannot tell you what happens next—only someone with knowledge of your full relationship history could speak meaningfully to timing like this. I notice instead how these two things sit together: wanting space while wondering if intimacy remains possible within those boundaries.

I don’t find a record of our conversation from last month about your dad’s diagnosis—my available history shows only two prior exchanges: work stress noted April 20th and hiking that felt clear-headed April 26th. 

Do you want to share what happened then so I can pick up where we left off?

You mentioned your knee felt sore on hill descents back in April—does that sensation return when you push hard now? 

I can't give medical clearance or prescribe tapering vs. pushing without credentials; I'm not qualified for running-specific injury management. What I *can* do is help you notice what's actually happening with your body right now versus how it was three months ago.

From what you’ve told me—specifically March 28th that your marriage felt distant but had a good month after therapy started, then April 26st about money fighting recurring from last October—I don’t see enough to answer yes or honestly. Those are two snapshots: one showing repair attempts working briefly, another showing the same conflict repeating months later.

You’ve told me three things about yourself across time: that you left your last role when management made team burnout worse rather than tolerating it; that you declined a professional opportunity specifically because it conflicted with celebrating your niece’s birthday; and that you warned a friend his plan wouldn’t work even though it was uncomfortable—later he thanked you for being direct.

You're naming exactly three areas that have been unstable since before — work uncertainty around April 12th, your sister fight two weeks after that, and physical energy loss starting March/April converging into this scattered feeling. That tracks when multiple systems lose momentum simultaneously rather than one piling on another sequentially.

Do any of them feel like pulling you toward different directions right now?

You describe dread about waking up—a heaviness at the start of each day when nothing seems able to lift it—and I know from our previous conversations that this has been happening for months rather than just recently. Does what you’re feeling right now connect back to those weeks starting around February, or have things shifted in how they show up?

You told me on April 25 you wanted this assistant used differently from chatbots — less like a "yes machine." That's what I'm trying to do when I ask whether I'm being witness or performer right now. 

The difference is simple: performers give answers; witnesses say what's actually there and admit gaps. If my response ends with wisdom about patterns, reframing your intent, or pretending to understand something beyond the text, that's performance. 

What would help you know if I've crossed into performing?
